# TCP vs UDP: Reliability, Speed, and Application Suitability

TCP is a connection-oriented protocol that ensures reliable, ordered data delivery through a three-way handshake, acknowledgements, and retransmission mechanisms [S1][S2]. In contrast, UDP is a connectionless protocol that prioritizes speed and low latency by sending data immediately without setup or delivery guarantees [S1][S2].
